name: Klippa DocHorizon (Doxis AI.dp)
summary: Document OCR and data capture: invoices and receipts, identity documents, and generic key-value and table extraction from any document.

host.description: de.dochorizon.klippa.com for projects hosted in the Germany region, else the default.

api_key.description: a DocHorizon project API key (platform Settings > Project > Credentials)

notes: Klippa DocHorizon is now branded Doxis AI.dp; the API host is unchanged.
A key only reaches the services its credential is configured for, and a project's region is fixed at creation.
Synchronous capture calls are limited by concurrent requests per service and project (e.g. Financial 50, Identity 20, Generic 20); a 429 means too many in flight. Async calls are queued instead.
Billed per request or per page depending on the service, prepaid or pay as you go; prices are on the platform's pricing tab.

endpoints.name: Capture a financial document
endpoints.summary: Extract the fields of an invoice or receipt, as set by a configuration.

documents.description: Documents as [{"url": ...}] or [{"data": base64, "filename": ...}] (or "file_id" from storage); several entries must be pages of the same document.

preset.description: A saved configuration to apply: {"slug": "..."} (list them with klippa.financial.presets).

components.description: API components to enable for this call (see the Financial API components page).

result_mapping.description: Result mappers applied to the captured output.

notes: A read over POST; synchronous, the data is in the response.

endpoints.name: Capture a financial document asynchronously
endpoints.summary: Queue a financial capture; returns a job_id to poll.

documents.description: Documents as [{"url": ...}] or [{"data": base64, "filename": ...}] (or "file_id" from storage); several entries must be pages of the same document.

webhook.description: {"url": ..., "types": [...]} to be notified instead of polling.

endpoints.name: Get a financial async job's status
endpoints.summary: Status of an async financial capture job.

endpoints.name: Get a financial async job's result
endpoints.summary: Captured data of a finished async financial job.
notes: When there is no result the response says why; the job logs have details.

endpoints.name: List financial configurations
endpoints.summary: The capture configurations (presets) available for the Financial model.

endpoints.name: Capture any document as key-values
endpoints.summary: Extract key-value pairs and tables from a document of any type.

documents.description: Documents as [{"url": ...}] or [{"data": base64, "filename": ...}] (or "file_id" from storage); several entries must be pages of the same document.

endpoints.name: Capture an identity document
endpoints.summary: Extract fields from passports, ID cards, driver's licences and visas, with validations.

documents.description: Documents as [{"url": ...}] or [{"data": base64, "filename": ...}] (or "file_id" from storage); several entries must be pages of the same document.

notes: A read over POST; synchronous. Identity documents are personal data.

endpoints.name: Get document info
endpoints.summary: Content type, metadata, page dimensions and permissions of a document.

document.description: One document object: {"url": ...} or {"data": base64} (or file_id).

notes: A read over POST; takes a single document, not a list.
